author: N6rL
content:
Toolchain + skeleton — the root of M0; everything else is blocked on this.

Scope:
- Install and pin uv + Python 3.14 (pyproject.toml, .python-version)
- Install and pin Rust toolchain (rust-toolchain.toml)
- Create package layout with four top-level modules matching DESIGN.md §3 layers:
    alcanzai-ingestion/   (Python — Source plugins)
    alcanzai-understanding/ (Python — Enrichers)
    alcanzai-core/        (Rust — Library spine, dedup, graph, projections, job orchestration)
    alcanzai-synthesis/   (Python — SynthesisService workers)
    alcanzai-interaction/ (Python — CLI / interaction surface entrypoint)
- Each module is an empty but valid package (pyproject.toml / Cargo.toml as appropriate)
- No cross-layer imports yet; just the skeleton

AC: uv run python -c 'pass' exits 0; cargo check in alcanzai-core exits 0; all module dirs exist and are importable/compilable; zero behavioral code — skeleton only.

Not salvage (fresh start per ROADMAP.md).
